tasks.title: ngv2/spawn_preflight.py — NEW Phase-8.2 5-gate spawn preflight (cascade/memory/capacity/dedup/cooldown) concept-ported pure with injected facts
acceptance_criteria: A NEW single file ngv2/spawn_preflight.py is created byte-for-byte from the brief Deliverables.
run_preflight(*, worker_type, ...) is pure, total, deterministic, stdlib-only — every external fact is an injected keyword argument.
The five gates run IN ORDER (cascade, memory, capacity, dedup, cooldown) and short-circuit on the first BLOCK.
cascade BLOCKS only when >= CASCADE_MIN_SAMPLE (4) recent completions exist and failed fraction > CASCADE_FAILURE_THRESHOLD (0.50).
memory BLOCKS when available_memory_mb is not None and < MEMORY_MIN_AVAILABLE_MB (2048); None skips the gate.
capacity BLOCKS when active_workers >= max_workers (default MAX_CONCURRENT_WORKERS=8).
dedup BLOCKS when task_target is in running_targets OR completed within dedup_window_s (default 300) of injected now; task_target None skips.
GO returns the full ordered gate list; BLOCK names blocked_by and the partial prefix of gates passed.
force=True short-circuits to GO with reason 'forced'.
No sqlite, psutil, filesystem, network, real clock, randomness, subprocess, LLM, or third-party imports in any path.
No other module is touched, imported, or altered; no __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ list is emitted.

spec.objective: Build a NEW orchestration module ngv2/spawn_preflight.py in the external NobleGreedv2 repo that concept-ports legacy services/spawn_preflight.py's 5-gate spawn preflight (the guard that killed legacy's rate-limit cascade self-DoS) while DISCARDING legacy's host probing: every fact is injected so run_preflight is pure, total, deterministic, and stdlib-only.
functional_requirements: Expose run_preflight(*, worker_type, task_target=None, recent_completions=None, available_memory_mb=None, active_workers=0, max_workers=8, running_targets=None, recent_target_completions=None, now=0.0, dedup_window_s=300, consecutive_failures=0, last_failure_at=None, force=False) -> dict returning {'verdict','blocked_by','reason','gates'}.
Gate 1 cascade: with >= CASCADE_MIN_SAMPLE (4) recent_completions (each a mapping with 'success' bool defaulting True), BLOCK when failed fraction > CASCADE_FAILURE_THRESHOLD (0.50).
Gate 2 memory: BLOCK when available_memory_mb is not None and below MEMORY_MIN_AVAILABLE_MB (2048); None skips the gate.
Gate 3 capacity: BLOCK when active_workers >= max_workers (default MAX_CONCURRENT_WORKERS=8).
Gate 4 dedup: when task_target is not None, BLOCK if it is in running_targets OR if recent_target_completions[task_target] is within dedup_window_s (default 300) of injected now.
Gate 5 cooldown: BLOCK while (now - last_failure_at) < _cooldown_seconds(consecutive_failures) where _cooldown_seconds = min(COOLDOWN_BASE_S(15) * 2**(n-1), COOLDOWN_MAX_S(180)).
Gates run IN ORDER and short-circuit on first BLOCK; GO returns full ordered gate list, BLOCK returns partial prefix passed and names blocked_by.

force=True short-circuits to GO with reason 'forced'; export constants MAX_CONCURRENT_WORKERS, CASCADE_FAILURE_THRESHOLD, CASCADE_MIN_SAMPLE, MEMORY_MIN_AVAILABLE_MB, DEDUP_COMPLETED_WINDOW_S, COOLDOWN_BASE_S, COOLDOWN_MAX_S and helper _cooldown_seconds.
spec.interfaces: NEW orchestration module ngv2/spawn_preflight.py exposing run_preflight(*, worker_type, task_target=None, recent_completions=None, available_memory_mb=None, active_workers=0, max_workers=8, running_targets=None, recent_target_completions=None, now=0.0, dedup_window_s=300, consecutive_failures=0, last_failure_at=None, force=False) -> dict, plus constants MAX_CONCURRENT_WORKERS, CASCADE_FAILURE_THRESHOLD, CASCADE_MIN_SAMPLE, MEMORY_MIN_AVAILABLE_MB, DEDUP_COMPLETED_WINDOW_S, COOLDOWN_BASE_S, COOLDOWN_MAX_S and helper _cooldown_seconds(consecutive_failures) -> int.
edge_cases: Fewer than 4 recent_completions: cascade gate is skipped (never blocks).
Exactly 50% failure rate with >=4 samples: does NOT block (strictly greater-than threshold).
task_target None: dedup gate skipped entirely.
completed exactly dedup_window_s ago: does NOT block (strictly less-than).
consecutive_failures <= 0: cooldown window is 0, gate never blocks.
last_failure_at None: cooldown gate skipped even with a positive streak.
elapsed exactly equal to cooldown window: does NOT block (strictly less-than).
force=True bypasses all five gates and returns reason 'forced'.
non_goals: Not an edit and not integration — do NOT author or modify any test; the oracle tests/test_spawn_preflight_wired.py is committed and authoritative.

Do NOT call sqlite, psutil, filesystem, network, a real clock, randomness, or subprocess in any path.
No LLM, no third-party imports (stdlib only); do NOT emit a __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ list.

Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.

## tests/test_spawn_preflight_wired.py
```python
import importlib
import pytest

sp = importlib.import_module("ngv2.spawn_preflight")


def test_module_is_live_ngv2():
    # in NGv2 this asserts the live package path
    assert hasattr(sp, "run_preflight")
    assert hasattr(sp, "MAX_CONCURRENT_WORKERS")


def test_clean_go():
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", task_target="o/r")
    assert r["verdict"] == "GO"
    assert r["blocked_by"] == ""
    assert r["gates"] == ["cascade", "memory", "capacity", "dedup", "cooldown"]


def test_cascade_blocks_on_high_failure():
    comps = [{"success": False}] * 3 + [{"success": True}]
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", recent_completions=comps)
    assert r["verdict"] == "BLOCKED"
    assert r["blocked_by"] == "cascade"
    assert r["gates"] == []


def test_cascade_ignored_below_min_sample():
    comps = [{"success": False}] * 3
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", recent_completions=comps)
    assert r["verdict"] == "GO"


def test_memory_floor_blocks():
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", available_memory_mb=1024)
    assert r["blocked_by"] == "memory"
    assert r["gates"] == ["cascade"]


def test_capacity_cap_blocks():
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", active_workers=8, max_workers=8)
    assert r["blocked_by"] == "capacity"
    assert r["gates"] == ["cascade", "memory"]


def test_dedup_running_blocks():
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", task_target="o/r", running_targets=["o/r"])
    assert r["blocked_by"] == "dedup"


def test_dedup_recent_completion_blocks():
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", task_target="o/r",
                         recent_target_completions={"o/r": 0.0}, now=100.0)
    assert r["blocked_by"] == "dedup"


def test_dedup_old_completion_allows():
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", task_target="o/r",
                         recent_target_completions={"o/r": 0.0}, now=1000.0)
    assert r["verdict"] == "GO"


def test_cooldown_exponential_blocks():
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", consecutive_failures=2,
                         last_failure_at=0.0, now=10.0)
    assert r["blocked_by"] == "cooldown"


def test_cooldown_elapsed_allows():
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", consecutive_failures=1,
                         last_failure_at=0.0, now=20.0)
    assert r["verdict"] == "GO"


def test_force_bypasses_all():
    r = sp.run_preflight(worker_type="hunt", available_memory_mb=0,
                         active_workers=99, max_workers=1, force=True)
    assert r["verdict"] == "GO"
    assert r["reason"] == "forced"


def test_cooldown_seconds_caps():
    assert sp._cooldown_seconds(0) == 0
    assert sp._cooldown_seconds(1) == 15
    assert sp._cooldown_seconds(2) == 30
    assert sp._cooldown_seconds(20) == 180

```
